authority_classes.UNKNOWN_UNRESOLVED: explicit blockers that cannot be silently removed

activation.first_activation: creates authority envelope and current pointer
activation.subsequent_activation: supersedes pointer target atomically and retains rollback anchor

validation.cardinality: candidate plan_shot_id sequence must equal baseline sequence
validation.timing: all action beat windows must fit duration
validation.continuity: character/prop state and screen direction transitions require explicit evidence
validation.unknowns: every closed unknown requires a typed resolution; remaining unknowns block activation
validation.tamper: payload, envelope, contract and upstream fingerprints are rechecked by resolver

consumer_gate.materializer: current pointer only; no latest-approved fallback
consumer_gate.storyboard_readiness: production resolves every ScriptIR scene through current ShotPlan pointer
consumer_gate.storyboard_agent: not called in production materializer path
consumer_gate.production_status: qualification blockers keep materialized output blocked
